text:
zara: hey all 👋 first-day intro + quick setup Qs — where's the best place to post a short "hello" bio (what to include)? also who do I DM to get added to the team calendar?

mike: welcome @zara! post a 2-3 line intro in #new-hires (name / role / pronouns / one fun fact). For team calendar invites DM @julie or `@hr-bot` and include your time zone.

julie: @zara i can add you to the team calendar once you post the intro. small preference: upload onboarding docs/receipts as replies in the #new-hires thread so People Ops can track the thread.

zara: awesome, thanks. another: where should i request repo access or deploy perms without pinging the whole eng team?

infra-bot: Repo access -> open an infra ticket at https://infra/tickets and paste the ticket link in #eng-platform-access. For deploy perms include manager approval and run `/access request repo=org/repo reason="onboarding"`.

mike: etiquette tips: use threads for follow-ups, add reactions instead of posting "thanks", avoid @channel unless it's genuinely urgent. Create private channels for filtered bot feeds.

zara: good call. bots keep me waking up at odd hours — how do i snooze them but not miss critical alerts?

onboard-bot: You can snooze channel notifications or set bot-level quiet hours. Example: `/dnd snooze channel=#release-notifs until=2026-03-24T09:00` or `@releases prefs quiet_hours=22:00-07:00 repo=org/repo`. Note: oncall/critical alerts may bypass DND depending on severity.

anna: heads-up: if you're posting logs or errors, redact tokens and creds. DM IT for anything sensitive. Use fenced code blocks for config snippets and include minimal repro steps.

zara: where do managers usually keep 1:1 notes or feedback? public channel or private?

julie: 1:1 notes are private. If you want to share wins/resources, post in #announcements or your team channel after confirming with your manager.

zara: perfect — posting intro + checklist now. thanks everyone! :tada:

hr-bot: Hi @zara — intro received. People Ops will confirm calendar invites and onboarding checklist status in-thread within 24 hours.
